content.json:
# Voice performance

Measured in the candidate's browser (App Insights JS SDK) and in the backend (OpenTelemetry). Every number is a duration in **milliseconds**; only timings, ids and outcomes are recorded, never text.

* **voice.setup** — one per voice connection, from opening the WebSocket.
* **voice.avatar** — one per avatar WebRTC handshake (first connect, recovery rebuild, media-mode switch). `stun_srflx_ms` = time to the STUN answer (first server-reflexive candidate), `turn_relay_ms` = time to the TURN allocation (first relay candidate), both from the offer.
* **voice.turn** — one per interviewer response; `kind = answer` turns include the candidate's answer. `click_to_audible_ms` is what the candidate feels: from finishing the answer to hearing the next question.

Metric definitions: `docs/voice-performance-telemetry.md`.

parameters.name: Interview
parameters.label: Interview (for the per-turn view)
parameters.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn"
| summarize last_seen = max(timestamp) by id = tostring(customDimensions.interview_id)
| order by last_seen desc
| take 50
| project value = id, label = strcat(id, "  (", format_datetime(last_seen, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), ")")

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.setup"
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array m = customMeasurements
| extend metric = tostring(m[0]), value = todouble(m[1])
| where metric endswith "_ms"
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(value, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(value, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(value, 95)), max = round(max(value)) by metric
| extend step = array_index_of(dynamic(["ws_open_ms", "proxy_connected_ms", "session_updated_ms", "first_video_frame_ms", "media_ready_ms", "first_audible_ms"]), metric)
| order by step asc
| project-away step
content.title: Setup stages, from opening the WebSocket

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.setup"
| summarize n = count() by outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome), avatar = tostring(customDimensions.avatar)
content.title: Setup outcomes

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.avatar"
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array m = customMeasurements
| extend metric = tostring(m[0]), value = todouble(m[1])
| where metric endswith "_ms"
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(value, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(value, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(value, 95)), max = round(max(value)) by metric
| extend step = array_index_of(dynamic(["create_offer_ms", "first_host_ms", "stun_srflx_ms", "turn_relay_ms", "ice_gather_ms", "sdp_answer_ms", "ice_connect_ms", "pc_connect_ms", "first_track_ms", "first_frame_ms", "total_ms", "total_audio_ms", "rtt_ms"]), metric)
| order by step asc
| project-away step
content.title: Handshake stages (ICE, STUN, TURN, SDP, first frame)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.avatar" and tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == "frame"
| extend path = strcat(tostring(customDimensions.local_candidate), " / ", tostring(customDimensions.protocol), iff(isempty(tostring(customDimensions.relay_protocol)), "", strcat(" via ", tostring(customDimensions.relay_protocol))))
| summarize n = count(), p50_total_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.total_ms), 50)), p95_total_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.total_ms), 95)), p50_rtt_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.rtt_ms), 50)) by path
| order by n desc
content.title: Selected candidate path and its cost

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.avatar"
| summarize n = count() by label = tostring(customDimensions.label), outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| order by label asc, n desc
content.title: Handshake outcomes by kind

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.avatar" and tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == "frame"
| summarize p50 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.total_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.total_ms), 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: Avatar time to first frame over time (p50 / p95)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.kind) == "answer"
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array m = customMeasurements
| extend metric = tostring(m[0]), value = todouble(m[1])
| where metric endswith "_ms"
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(value, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(value, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(value, 95)), max = round(max(value)) by metric
| extend step = array_index_of(dynamic(["speaking_ms", "stt_ms", "commit_wait_ms", "answer_http_ms", "answer_to_read_ms", "read_to_created_ms", "created_to_first_text_ms", "created_to_first_audio_delta_ms", "created_to_audible_ms", "response_ms", "click_to_audible_ms", "stop_to_audible_ms"]), metric)
| order by step asc
| project-away step
content.title: Answered-turn stages

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.kind) == "opening"
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array m = customMeasurements
| extend metric = tostring(m[0]), value = todouble(m[1])
| where metric endswith "_ms"
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(value, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(value, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(value, 95)), max = round(max(value)) by metric
| extend step = array_index_of(dynamic(["speaking_ms", "stt_ms", "commit_wait_ms", "answer_http_ms", "answer_to_read_ms", "read_to_created_ms", "created_to_first_text_ms", "created_to_first_audio_delta_ms", "created_to_audible_ms", "response_ms", "click_to_audible_ms", "stop_to_audible_ms"]), metric)
| order by step asc
| project-away step
content.title: Opening reads (question 1, no answer before it)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.kind) == "answer"
| summarize p50 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.click_to_audible_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.click_to_audible_ms), 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: What the candidate feels: answer finished → next question heard (p50 / p95)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.interview_id) == "{Interview}"
| project timestamp, turn = toint(customDimensions.turn_index), turn_kind = tostring(customDimensions.kind), heard = tostring(customDimensions.heard),
    stt_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.stt_ms), commit_wait_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.commit_wait_ms), answer_http_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.answer_http_ms),
    answer_to_read_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.answer_to_read_ms), read_to_created_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.read_to_created_ms),
    created_to_audible_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.created_to_audible_ms), click_to_audible_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.click_to_audible_ms), response_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.response_ms)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Per-turn breakdown for the selected interview

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.kind) == "answer"
| summarize n = count(), p50_click_to_audible_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.click_to_audible_ms), 50)), p50_answer_http_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.answer_http_ms), 50)) by audio_path = tostring(customDimensions.audio_path), linear_turns = tostring(customDimensions.linear_turns)
content.title: Audio path and pipeline split

content.json:
## Backend (OpenTelemetry spans)

`answer_http_ms` above includes the brain/judge work below plus the network; the spans say which part it was.

content.query:
union dependencies, requests
| where name in ("voice.session", "judge.call", "external_brain.turn", "scoring.question")
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(duration, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(duration, 95)), max = round(max(duration)), failed = countif(success == false) by name
content.title: Business spans

content.query:
requests
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95 = round(percentile(duration, 95)), failed = countif(success == false) by name
| where n >= 3
| top 15 by p95 desc
content.title: Slowest API routes (server side)

content.query:
dependencies
| where type !in ("InProc")
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95 = round(percentile(duration, 95)), failed = countif(success == false) by type, target
| top 15 by n desc
content.title: Outbound calls (Azure OpenAI, external brain, storage, database)

content.query:
traces
| where message == "voice.azure_error"
| summarize n = count() by code = tostring(customDimensions.code), avatar_rate_limited = tostring(customDimensions.avatar_rate_limited), bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Voice Live errors from Azure (avatar rate limit included)
